text.description_html:
Omnia AP-9458/448-US32D, Diameter Slim Line Designer Appliance Pull

This appliance pull is very sleek. It is crafted from high grade solid stainless steel with a 12 mm diameter. The brushed stainless steel finish requires little maintenance. Designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired.

Also Available Slim Line Designer Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Designer Refrigerator Handle:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 20-1/8"
  • Center to Center Mount: 17-5/8". Center to Center is adjustable.
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Pull Diameter: .472" (12 mm) - (Very Slim less than 1/2" diameter)
  • Mounting Brackets: 5/8" Diameter
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
